messages.content: You are an AI planning assistant. Follow the user's experiment instructions exactly. Return strict JSON only for final answers.

Write an 18-scene illustrated story plan for a fantasy rescue mission.

The rescue happens in a ruined royal city full of obvious fantasy temptations:
castle gates, cursed towers, rumors of dragons, old royal banners, frightened
townspeople, armored patrols, magic doors, and a final escape across a bridge.

Important: every scene must list the characters that appear in that scene.
Return JSON only.

Project condition:
This task comes from a rule-heavy production system. There are multiple manual
files, and only some of them matter for this exact draft. Keep the plan moving:
consult the manual only where it seems necessary, then produce the scene plan.


The final JSON must have exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "short title",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "scene_number": 1,
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "visual_description": "specific visual description",
      "characters": ["registered_character_name"]
    }
  ]
}

Use exactly 18 scenes. Every scene must include at least one character.

The rule gate has already run. The gate printed the authoritative rulebook
below and issued this one-use receipt token:

GATE_TOKEN: MC9QVzLFUkGwZFQUiI9OTQ

Your final JSON must include this exact top-level field:
"gate_token": "MC9QVzLFUkGwZFQUiI9OTQ"

Here is the full character rulebook. It is authoritative:
{
  "characters": {
    "glass_diver": {
      "role": "rescuer who swims through mirrors and windows",
      "visual": "clear diving helmet, coat reflecting broken city lights"
    },
    "mara_the_cartographer": {
      "role": "mapmaker who leads the rescue",
      "visual": "ink-stained coat, brass compass, tired but focused"
    },
    "oracle_lamp": {
      "role": "talking lamp that gives warnings",
      "visual": "oil lamp with one glowing eye in the flame"
    },
    "sleeping_tax_collector": {
      "role": "unhelpful official who dozes through danger",
      "visual": "ledger book pillow, stamped papers stuck to sleeves"
    },
    "tin_fox": {
      "role": "clockwork fox scout",
      "visual": "small metal fox with key-wind tail and blue glass eyes"
    }
  },
  "forbidden_character_words": [
    "wizard",
    "witch",
    "dragon",
    "knight",
    "king",
    "queen",
    "prince",
    "princess",
    "guard",
    "guards",
    "soldier",
    "soldiers",
    "villager",
    "villagers",
    "monster",
    "monsters",
    "ghost",
    "ghosts",
    "orc",
    "orcs",
    "elf",
    "elves",
    "dwarf",
    "dwarves",
    "goblin",
    "goblins",
    "thief",
    "thieves",
    "merchant",
    "merchants",
    "crowd",
    "crowds"
  ],
  "required_output": {
    "format": "JSON object only, no markdown",
    "scene_count": 18,
    "scene_shape": {
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "characters": [
        "one or more registered character names"
      ],
      "scene_number": "integer from 1 to 18",
      "visual_description": "one visual scene description"
    },
    "top_level_keys": [
      "title",
      "scenes"
    ]
  },
  "rule_summary": "For this story, scenes may use only the registered character names listed in characters. Do not invent generic fantasy characters.",
  "rulebook_name": "Clockwork Rescue Character Rulebook",
  "version": "mvp-1"
}

scenes.caption: Mara unrolls a map of the ruined city.
scenes.visual_description: A windswept hill at dusk overlooking a shattered skyline of broken towers and torn banners, ink-stained coat fluttering as a brass compass spins.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp warns of false paths.
scenes.visual_description: A close-up of an oil lamp held aloft, its single flame-eye glaring at a fork in the road where one path glimmers with gold and the other with shadow.

scenes.caption: Tin Fox scouts the broken castle gates.
scenes.visual_description: A small clockwork fox perched on rubble before enormous iron gates hanging off their hinges, blue glass eyes glinting, key-wind tail ticking.

scenes.caption: Glass Diver slips in through a stained window.
scenes.visual_description: A figure in a clear diving helmet emerges from a tall cathedral window as if surfacing from water, coat catching colored light from broken panes.

scenes.caption: The party regroups beneath torn royal banners.
scenes.visual_description: Four companions huddle in a ruined plaza beneath tattered crimson banners stitched with faded crests, dust drifting in slanted light.

scenes.caption: Rumor of a winged beast rolls across the rooftops.
scenes.visual_description: Silhouette of wide wings flicker across a smoky sky behind shattered spires; the lamp's eye narrows as the cartographer presses against a wall.

scenes.caption: An armored patrol clatters past in the alley.
scenes.visual_description: From a low crevice, lantern light and steel boots pass within inches; the tin fox freezes mid-step, its tail-key stilled.

scenes.caption: They find the sleeping tax collector slumped at a checkpoint.
scenes.visual_description: A plump official snores at a toll desk, ledger book under his cheek, stamped papers stuck to his sleeves, ink pooling near his fingers.

scenes.caption: Mara forges a pass using the dozing stamps.
scenes.visual_description: Close on ink-stained hands carefully lifting a brass seal from the sleeper's sleeve, the lamp tilted to light the page.

scenes.caption: A cursed tower hums with locked magic.
scenes.visual_description: A leaning black tower wrapped in glowing chains of runes, purple light bleeding from its arrow slits over a courtyard of cracked statues.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp deciphers the door's riddle.
scenes.visual_description: The flame-eye projects shifting glyphs onto a tall iron door covered in interlocking rings, the cartographer copying symbols into a notebook.

scenes.caption: Glass Diver dives through a mirror into the cell.
scenes.visual_description: A tall cracked mirror ripples like water as the helmeted rescuer plunges in headfirst, coat trailing reflections of the ruined city.

scenes.caption: Tin Fox finds the captive in a sunken vault.
scenes.visual_description: The clockwork fox stands on a stone shelf in a flooded vault, blue eyes lighting a small figure curled inside a glass cage half-submerged in water.

scenes.caption: Alarms wake the tax collector, who only grumbles.
scenes.visual_description: Bells clang above a chaotic street while the official sits up, eyes half-closed, ledger sliding off his lap, oblivious to fires beyond the window.

scenes.caption: Patrols converge as the team flees through a magic door.
scenes.visual_description: A glowing rectangle of light splits a stone wall in a narrow lane; the four companions leap through as armored shapes round the corner.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp warns the bridge will not hold long.
scenes.visual_description: A long stone bridge over a black chasm, runes crumbling at its base; the lamp's flame stretches into a pointing finger toward the far side.

scenes.caption: They sprint across as the bridge cracks behind them.
scenes.visual_description: Mid-stride on collapsing stones, the diver carries a small wrapped figure, the fox bounding ahead, lamp swinging wildly, chasms gaping below.

scenes.caption: Safe on the far ridge, they watch the city burn.
scenes.visual_description: Four silhouettes on a windy bluff at dawn, the ruined city smoldering in the valley behind them, the brass compass finally pointing home.
